title: Horror
story: A cozy spooky movie night, with all the classic scares turned friendly.

cards.name: Haunted House
cards.subject: A tall crooked mansion with a pointed roof, a round attic window and a crooked chimney.
cards.hero_colors: gray-brown walls, dark purple roof, yellow glowing windows
cards.backdrop_colors: bright sky blue with a big yellow moon

cards.name: Witch Hat
cards.subject: A tall pointed hat with a wide curved brim and a buckled band.
cards.hero_colors: black hat, purple band, small yellow buckle

cards.name: Pumpkin
cards.subject: A round orange pumpkin carved with triangle eyes and a zigzag grin, with a short green stem.
cards.hero_colors: orange pumpkin, green stem, yellow glowing face

cards.name: Cauldron
cards.subject: A round black pot with three short legs, two side handles and bubbling liquid at the top.
cards.hero_colors: black iron, bright green bubbling potion, small orange flame

cards.name: Coffin
cards.subject: A six-sided wooden coffin with a slightly open lid and a cross on the front.
cards.hero_colors: brown wood, tan cross, small purple cloth lining
cards.backdrop_colors: clear cyan sky with a yellow moon

cards.name: Tombstone
cards.subject: A rounded gray gravestone with a cracked corner and a small cross carved on top.
cards.hero_colors: light gray stone, green moss patch, small orange accent

cards.name: Candelabra
cards.subject: A golden candle holder with three curved arms, a tall stem and a round base, each arm holding a lit candle.
cards.hero_colors: gold holder, cream candles, small orange flames

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.subject: A clear glass sphere with a swirl of mist inside, sitting on a small curved stand.
cards.hero_colors: clear blue glass, white mist, gold stand, small pink sparkle

cards.name: Black Cat
cards.subject: A sitting black cat with pointed ears, a curved tail and big round eyes.
cards.hero_colors: black fur, yellow eyes, small red collar

cards.name: Broom
cards.subject: A long wooden stick with a bundle of straw bristles tied with a cord at the end.
cards.hero_colors: brown stick, golden straw, small red cord

source: the final horror cards, redrawn from Blender blockouts
